text.p: Tropical Cyclone Elvina, with 60 mph winds, is in the South Indian Ocean, northeast of Rodrigues Island, near 14s/77e, moving slowly southwest. Slow strengthening may occur as this track continues through 24 hours, threatening only shipping.

Tropical Cyclone 10S, with 35 mph winds, is in the Timor Sea near 13s/124e, moving southwest at 6 mph. Strengthening is expected as the storm tracks southwest. At this time, it is no direct threat to land, but may eventually threaten Northwest Australia with strong winds and heavy rainfall.
